h1: Winning UGC Videos for Your Facebook Ads

faq.q: Where should the price and the offer line go?
faq.a: Put the price and offer where Facebook’s controls will not cover them. Check the final video on a phone before running the ad.

faq.q: How fast can I make an AI Facebook ad?
faq.a: You can make a Facebook ad in a few minutes. Choose an actor, add your product message, and generate a file without waiting on a shoot.

faq.q: Will people know the ad is made by AI?
faq.a: Viewers may or may not recognize an AI actor. Follow Facebook’s disclosure rules and do not present a generated person as a real customer.

faq.q: How many credits does a Facebook video ad cost?
faq.a: A 6, 10, 15, or 30 second video costs 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits. Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro $35 for 300, and Premium $63 for 600. Failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: Are AI videos allowed in Facebook Ads?
faq.a: Yes, AI videos can run as Facebook ads when they follow Meta’s rules. Keep claims truthful, avoid impersonation, and disclose AI use when required.

faq.q: Can AI UGC ads work on Facebook?
faq.a: It can work well when the ad feels natural in the feed and shows the product quickly. Test different openings and audiences to see what performs for your shop.

faq.q: Can I stop paying a creator for every Facebook test?
faq.a: Yes. Make several Facebook ad versions from one product photo without paying a creator for each test. You can change the actor or message in minutes.

faq.q: What is AI UGC for Facebook Ads?
faq.a: An AI Facebook UGC ad is a creator-style product video made with an AI actor and voice. You can make one without hiring a creator or filming.

benefits_h2: Reasons to Switch to Facebook UGC Ads

benefits.d: More of the Facebook budget can buy reach, because a new clip costs less to make than hiring a creator for every test.
When the offer changes, you make a new Facebook video while that offer is still the one you want to run. You are not waiting on a creator who is booked out.
